column3: What is the toxicological information available for the product?
column4: The product contains slightly hazardous information in case of eye contact (irritant), extremely dangerous in case of ingestion, slightly hazardous in case of inhalation (lung irritant) with potential effects like nausea, headaches, and vomiting, and slightly hazardous in case of skin contact (irritant). Repeated or prolonged exposure may produce target organs damage. It is also mentioned that the substance can be toxic to kidneys and liver. The product contains ethylene glycol, which has an LD50: 4700 mg/kg (oral/rat) and LD50: 9530 mg/kg (dermal/rabbit).

column3: What are the safety precautions and handling instructions for using the product?
column4: To use this product safely, keep container dry and tightly closed. Store in a cool, well-ventilated place, avoiding contamination with reactive substances. After handling, wash hands thoroughly with soap and water. Wear appropriate footwear to prevent the product from coming into contact with feet and skin. Personal protective equipment varies depending on conditions of use, but as a minimum, wear long sleeves and trousers to prevent skin contact. For normal application, special ventilation is not necessary; however, if user operations generate vapors or mist, use ventilation to keep exposure below exposure limits.

column3: What are the specific health effects or risks associated with exposure to the product?
column4: The substance may be toxic to kidneys and liver. Repeated or prolonged exposure can produce target organs damage, general deterioration of health by an accumulation in one or many human organs. Slightly hazardous in case of eye contact (irritant). Extremely dangerous in case of ingestion. Slightly hazardous in case of inhalation (lung irritant), which can cause nausea, headaches, and vomiting. Slightly hazardous in case of skin contact (irritant). Can also be fetotoxic and teratogenic in mice at levels below maternal toxicity.
